definitions.short: properly, hinder ; generally, next , other , etc.
definitions.full: H312. acher I. אַחֵר adjective another (properly one coming behind ), feminine אַחֶ֫רֶת (with daghesh forte implicit); plural אֲחֵרִים (as if from singular אָחֵר ), once Job 31:10 אֲחֵרוֺת אֲחֵרִין, (= Arabic , Sabean אאחֿר , Assyrian a—ru future feminine plural as substantive a—rat ûmê future of days) Gen 4:25 אַחֵר זֶרַע another seed 8:10 אֲחֵרִים יָמִים שִׁבְעַת seven other days Exod 22:4 אַחֵר בִּשְׂדֵה in the field of another + often; אַחֵר אִישׁ another man (husband) Gen 29:19 ; Deut 24:2 ; Jer 3:1 ; הָאַחֶרֶת חָצֵר 1Kin 7:8 the other court, see חָצֵר ; א ׳הַחוֺמָה 2Chr 32:5 the other wall, see חוֺמָה . Appended to a proper name for distinction Ezra 2:31 = Neh 7:34 (see 7:7 = Nehemiah 7:12 ) 7:33 (probably here text error, see Be Ry 18 : not in Ezra 2:29 ). Often with the collateral sense of different , as א ׳בְּגָדִים other garments Lev 6:4 ; 1Sam 28:8 ; Ezek 42:14 ; 44:19 ; אֲבָנִים עָפָר, Lev 14:42 ; רוּחַ Num 14:24 ; אַ לְאִישׁ ׳וְנֶהְמַּכְתָּ֫ 1Sam 10:6 ; לֵב 10:9 ; Ezek 11:19 ( ᵐ5 Hi Sm); שֵׁם Isa 65:15 (compare 62:2 חָדָשׁ ); with that of strange, alien , as אַ ׳אִישׁ Deut 20:5-6 , 7 ; 28:30 ( so אֲחֵרִים אַחֵר, alone Psa 109:8 ; Job 31:8 , 10 ; Isa 65:22 ; Jer 6:12 ; 8:10 and elsewhere); עַם Deut 28:32 ; אֶרֶץ 29:27 ; Jer 22:26 ; אִשָּׁה Judg 11:2 ; לָשׁוֺן Isa 28:11 (|| שָׂפָה בְּלַעֲגֵי ); especially in the phrase אֲחֵרִים אֱלהִים other gods (63 t.) Exod 20:3 (= Deut 5:7 ) 23:13 (both J E) Josh 24:2 , 16 (E) 1Sam 26:19 ; Hosea 3:1 , & particularly in Deuteronomy (Hosea 6:14; Deut 8:19 15 t.) & Deuteronomic writers, as Josh 23:16 ; Judg 2:12 , 17 , 19 Jeremiah (18 t.) & compiler of Kings; אַחֵר אֵל once Exod 34:14 (JE). So אַחֵר alone Isa 42:8 ; Psa 16:4 . Of time, following, next (rare) הָאַ ׳בַּשָּׁנָה Gen 17:21 (P) in the next year; 2Kin 6:29 הָאַ ׳בַּיּוֺם ; אַ ׳דּוֺר Joel 1:3 ; Psa 109:13 in poetry the next Generation ( Judg 2:10 in prose = another Generation).
